'''Ayor-v9''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] member of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]]. He was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Reneget Vause]] and preferred to spend time with his many [[Droid/Legends|droids]], considering them "his family." In [[3642 BBY]] he was confronted and killed by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], who sought to draw Vause out of hiding.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ayor-v9 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
